name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Analytics Consultant | Marketing & Customer Analytics, AI-Driven Decision Support

Direct retail-industry experience building e-commerce presence for established retail businesses at Wix and managing a retail-vertical partner book at Birdeye.
